acceptanceCriteria: Every remaining remote branch has a recorded disposition with PR state, merge fact, worktree state, and blocker or cleanup evidence.
Runtime-generated archive, finalization, and close records are used; historical evidence bytes are not rewritten or deleted.
Only exact clean merged branch and worktree resources are removed after finalization verification.
The cleanup Work Item itself passes reviewed PR integration, archive, close, and documentation promotion checks.
authority: explicit user authorization in active development instruction
goal: Produce an evidence-bound disposition for every remaining release branch, archive and close only Work Items that satisfy the Runtime lifecycle, preserve dirty or divergent evidence, and remove only exact clean merged resources.
intent: Finalize merged Work Item lifecycle records and safely remove only exact merged branch and worktree resources.
outOfScope: dirty worktrees and branches with unmerged or divergent content

scenarioCoverage.expected: Every current non-main remote branch has exactly one evidence-bound disposition covering PR state, merge fact, worktree state, and blocker or cleanup status.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare the live remote branch inventory with the consolidated PR and worktree inventory and record the resulting disposition report.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Dirty, divergent, unmerged, or evidence-insufficient branches and worktrees are preserved and explicitly blocked from deletion.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Re-observe each flagged branch and worktree, confirm its preservation state, and verify that no deletion operation targets it.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Only an exact clean merged branch and its exact clean worktree are removed after Runtime finalization verification; unrelated resources remain untouched.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: For each cleanup candidate, compare branch tip, reviewed merge fact, close receipt, finalization receipt, and worktree cleanliness before a serialized deletion, then re-observe the exact postcondition.
